{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''unidentified organization''' was active while the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] was in service with [[Zahara Cody]] as its [[chief medical officer]]. Zahara's father, [[Teef Lan Cody]], was aware of the organization and his child decided to join it.

==Behind the scenes==
The name of this organization was redacted from the text of one of the in-universe letters that made up ''[[Death Troopers: Recovered Messages from Purge]]'', a tie-in to the novel ''[[Death Troopers]]''.
